crossRefs.note: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…
He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the…
My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.

translations.web: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.
translations.bsb: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or turn from them.
translations.kjv: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
translations.asv: Get wisdom, get understanding; Forget not, neither decline from the words of my mouth;
